brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Briefing covers key developments across Geopolitics, Climate Governance, Quantum Security, Digital Public Infrastructure, and Environmental Conservation.

articles.title: Expansion of India-Nordic-Baltic (NB8) Partnership in Renewable Tech & Maritime Security
articles.summary: India and the Nordic-Baltic Eight (NB8) agreed to deepen cooperation on green hydrogen, critical mineral supply chains, and Arctic research.
prelims: NB8 comprises 5 Nordic countries (Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden) and 3 Baltic countries (Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania).
The primary areas of collaboration include the Blue Economy, green transition, AI governance, and Arctic scientific research.
The initiative builds upon the framework established during the inaugural India-Nordic Summit held in Stockholm.
articles.mains: Examine the strategic significance of the Nordic-Baltic grouping for India's long-term energy transition and Arctic policy objectives.

articles.title: BEE Outlines Operational Regulations for the Indian Carbon Market (ICM)
articles.summary: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) releases functional compliance standards for the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) targeting high-emission industrial sectors.
prelims: CCTS was notified under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001 (as amended in 2022).
The National Steering Committee for the Indian Carbon Market (NSCICM) is chaired by the Secretary, Ministry of Power.
Grid Controller of India Limited (Grid-India) acts as the official registry for Carbon Credit Certificates (CCCs).
articles.mains: Discuss how the Indian Carbon Market can effectively balance domestic industrial growth with India's updated Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement.

articles.title: Indigenously Developed Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) Integrated into Defence Communication Networks
articles.summary: Under the National Quantum Mission (NQM), India's defence sector successfully deploys secure Quantum Key Distribution protocols over long-distance military fiber routes.
prelims: The National Quantum Mission (NQM) is implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
QKD uses fundamental principles of quantum mechanics (superposition and entanglement) to ensure secure key exchange resistant to quantum decryption.
NQM targets developing intermediate-scale quantum computers with 50-1000 physical qubits over an eight-year roadmap.
articles.mains: Analyze the critical role of emerging quantum technologies in safeguarding national communications infrastructure against futuristic cyber threats.

articles.title: NHA Releases ABDM 2.0 Norms for Interoperability and Digital Health Data Privacy
articles.summary: The National Health Authority (NHA) updates protocols under the Unified Health Interface (UHI) to streamline digital consent management across healthcare providers.
prelims: The National Health Authority (NHA) is the apex body responsible for implementing the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM).
ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) provides citizens with a 14-digit unique health identification number.
Unified Health Interface (UHI) works on open protocols, enabling seamless interoperability across digital health services akin to UPI in banking.
articles.mains: Evaluate the role of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) in improving healthcare delivery and discuss the operational challenges in ensuring patient data privacy under the DPDP Act.

articles.title: India Reaches Milestone of 100 Ramsar Sites Under 'Amrit Dharohar' Initiative
articles.summary: India adds key inland wetland ecosystems to the Ramsar List, reaching 100 designated Wetlands of International Importance while boosting community-led eco-tourism.
prelims: The Ramsar Convention on Wetlands was adopted in 1971 in Ramsar, Iran; India became a contracting party in 1982.
The 'Amrit Dharohar' scheme promotes non-consumptive use of wetlands, local community livelihoods, and carbon sequestration.
The Montreux Record is a register of Ramsar sites where ecological character changes have occurred, are occurring, or are likely to occur due to human interference.
articles.mains: Highlight the ecological importance of wetland restoration in climate change adaptation and evaluate community-centric strategies for sustainable wetland management.
